title: Wo ghar ke hukm jahan
body:
Wo ghar ke hukm jahan
Sayyada, tahera, raaziya, marziya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n Fatima ke chalte hai..(2)
Tamaam kaam wahi'n se..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke chalte hai...
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamaam kaam wahi'n se..(2)
khuda ke chalte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
Ye kaisi raah guzar hai, ye kaun sa darr hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ke Mustafa bhi yaha'n sarr jhuka ke chalte hai
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
<<DIVIDER>>
Jabee'n pe fakhr se rumaal e Sayyeda bandhe..(2)
amame walo'n me hurr muskura ke chalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
Ke jaise haath me al-maeda ka sura ho..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
malak yu rotiya'n teri uthake chalte hai
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
<<DIVIDER>>
Bana na le koi duniya uthake wo mitti..(2)
yu nakhshe paa tere Haider chupa ke chalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
Ae hurr na ghabra ye karbobala ki basti hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
yaha'n pe faisle aale abaa ke chalte hai
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye tere faaqo'n ka sadqa hai aye Hussain ki maa..(2)
jo ghar sukoon se ehle azaa ke chalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
Kaha ajal se takallum ne intezaar karo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
sana e Fatema Zahra sunake chalte hai
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamaam kaam wahi'n se..(2)
khuda ke chalte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo ghar ke hukm jaha'n...
author: Mir Hassan Mir
